page.notes: Long s and u/v normalised as instructed. Doubtful readings: "errones" (printed as in the scan, possibly for "errores"); "facti" (the i is slightly broken in the scan). "Sauli" is italic in the original. The catchword "maio-" is the last word-fragment at the foot right. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and was excluded.
